messages:
tara: quick heads-up: performing table swap and backfill for orders.party.id -> orders.party_v2 in ~15m maintenance window. initial canary 1% then ramp.
sam: what's the exclusive lock estimate for the final swap?
tara: expecting ~60s. we'll quiesce app dynos for 90s to be safe.
db-team: safe-rename helper primed; it checks pg_stat_activity and refuses to proceed if >2 long transactions.
deploybot: preflight OK. holdpoint scheduled at 5100001240 by tara.
ops-bot: runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/migrations/orders-party-swap. monitors: db_lock_rate, read_p99, backfill_rows_per_min. alerts configured.
ivy: pinning service-runner to 4.0.1 for this rollout; older runtimes will ignore new column.
sam: paste abort steps?
tara: abort quick steps:
```
# stop backfill workers
kubectl -n prod scale deployment orders-backfill --replicas=0
# disable feature flag
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/migrations -d '{\"orders_party_v2\":false}'
# if rename partially applied: rollback helper
psql -c 'SELECT rollback_safe_swap(\'orders_party_swap\');'
```
db-team: monitoring now. canary backfill ~7k rows/min, no locks observed.
deploybot: canary started routing=1% at 5100001250.
tara: gating to 25% requires 10m stable p99 (< +12% baseline), db_lock_rate <0.25%, backfill progress >40%.
sam: noted. release notes will include launcher pin, quiesce window, rollback commands, and runbook.
deploybot: holdpoint released at 5100001259 by tara.
